svg.title: An effect's round trip
svg.desc: During a turn, Receive calls lockstep.Do with an effect such as Charge, named payment.charge, and a done function. Do returns at once. On the production engine, the effect's Run method does the real I/O on a bounded pool: 64 effects at a time and 1024 waiting by default. In simulation, Run is never called; the handler registered with s.HandleEffect returns a value, an error and a latency drawn from the seed. Either way, done turns the result into a message, which arrives in the actor's mailbox and is handled in a later turn. An effect times out after 30 seconds by default, and a stop or restart cancels the effects the incarnation started. From https://github.com/hmdsefi/lockstep.
